services.desc: Every cruise with the Spirit of Ethan Allen is a journey into fun, flavor and unforgettable views. Whether you're looking to explore, indulge or celebrate, we've got the perfect cruise for you. All that's left is to choose your perfect cruise, and let the Spirit of Ethan Allen take care of the rest! Our Office is open between 8:00am and 5:00pm Monday - Friday. blurb: Guests board the Spirit of Ethan Allen for cruises on Lake Champlain featuring scenic views, upbeat DJs, and engaging tour narration. The crew focuses on guest enjoyment throughout the cruise. The business operates cashless, accepting Visa, Mastercard, and Discover only.

quotes.text: Our wedding was perfect on The Spirit of Ethan Allen! The employees were courteous, helpful, and more than accommodating with anything we needed throughout the evening. The food was excellent and fresh (guests were raving about it after dinner) and they did a great job decorating the boat deck as we had planned! I would highly recommend this beautiful venue for a wedding!
